facts.raw_span: A man in his 70s
history of coronary artery bypass surgery
ejection fraction of 25%
biventricular pacemaker placement
dull chest pain of 2 hours' duration
sinus activity at 72 beats/min
normal PR interval
QRS duration of 160 milliseconds
ST segment depression >1mm in V2 and V3
new discordant ST elevation of 1mm in leads II, III, and aVF
Initial troponin (2 hours after symptom onset): Negative
thrombotic occlusion of saphenous vein graft proximal to circumflex anastomosis

concepts.why: The patient presents with dull chest pain and ECG changes, including ST segment depression and discordant ST elevation, which are indicative of acute coronary syndrome.
The patient has thrombotic occlusion of a saphenous vein graft and occlusive lesions in the proximal obtuse marginal artery, which are consistent with myocardial infarction.
The patient has a history of coronary artery bypass surgery and presents with chest pain and ECG changes, indicating cardiac ischemia.
The patient has a low ejection fraction and a biventricular pacemaker, which are indicative of heart failure.
The patient has thrombotic occlusion of a saphenous vein graft, which is a specific type of coronary artery occlusion.
It explains the negative initial troponin with subsequent thrombotic occlusion of saphenous vein graft and occlusive lesions in proximal obtuse marginal artery.

rationales.F02: History of coronary artery bypass surgery increases the likelihood of Acute Coronary Syndrome, Myocardial Infarction, and Cardiac Ischemia.
rationales.F03: Low ejection fraction is a strong indicator of Heart Failure and increases the likelihood of Acute Coronary Syndrome, Myocardial Infarction, and Cardiac Ischemia.
rationales.F09: ST segment depression is a strong indicator of Acute Coronary Syndrome, Myocardial Infarction, and Cardiac Ischemia.
rationales.F10: Discordant ST elevation is a strong indicator of Acute Coronary Syndrome, Myocardial Infarction, and Cardiac Ischemia.
rationales.F12: Thrombotic occlusion of saphenous vein graft is a strong indicator of Acute Coronary Syndrome, Myocardial Infarction, and Cardiac Ischemia, as well as Saphenous Vein Graft Occlusion.

frontier_selector.rationale: Thrombotic occlusion of saphenous vein graft proximal to circumflex anastomosis directly supports Saphenous Vein Graft Occlusion, with Acute Coronary Syndrome being a broader category that also fits the clinical presentation.
